# Tool catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-tool-docs.mjs from the MCP tool registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool the MCP server registers. **read** tools never change anything. **write** tools change platform state,
and **⚠️ write** marks tools that can replace or remove it. The guard after the access level says how a write
is applied: **confirm** returns a dry-run preview until called with `confirm: true`; **preview token** needs the
single-use token returned by the matching `preview_*` tool; **immediate** acts on the first call, so confirm
intent with the user first. Production environments add their own checks; see the [safety model](safety.md).
A `?` marks an optional input.

## Identity and organization

Start here to confirm access and discover environments.

| Tool | Access | Inputs | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `whoami` | read | — | Returns the currently authenticated Anypoint Platform user, their username, email, organization name, and org ID. |
| `list_environments` | read | — | Lists all Anypoint environments in the organization (e.g. Development, Sandbox, Production). |
| `get_entitlements` | read | — | Returns the platform features and capacity licensed for this organization: vCore allocations (production/sandbox/design), Anypoint MQ quotas, Object Store limits, API Manager, monitoring, Runtime Fabric, autoscaling, alerts, and subscription type/expiration. |

## Project profile

Bind a workspace to a named credential profile.

| Tool | Access | Inputs | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_project_profile` | read | — | Returns the currently active Anypoint profile for this project, how it was resolved (flag, env, project-file, or default), and lists all available profiles. |
| `set_project_profile` | write · immediate | `profile`, `directory?` | Binds the current project directory to a named Anypoint profile by writing .anypoint-connect.json. |

## Applications — read

CloudHub 2.0 deployment state, specs, settings and cross-environment comparison.

| Tool | Access | Inputs | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list_apps` | read | `environment` | Lists all Mule applications deployed in a CloudHub 2.0 environment. |
| `get_app_status` | read | `appName`, `environment` | Returns detailed deployment information for a specific Mule application: status, artifact version (groupId:artifactId:version), Mule runtime version, resource allocation (CPU, memory, vCores), autoscaling config, JVM args, clustering, each replica's state and deployment location, the public URL, and last update timestamp. |
| `get_deployment_spec` | read | `appName`, `environment` | Returns the full current deployment spec for a CloudHub 2.0 application — the "look before you leap" view used before a redeploy or rollback. |
| `get_app_resources` | read | `environment` | Returns resource allocation for all apps in an environment: CPU/memory limits and reservations, vCores, replica count, autoscaling config, and JVM args. |
| `get_app_settings` | read | `appName`, `environment` | Reads the application properties (configuration settings) for a deployed Mule application in CloudHub 2.0. |
| `compare_app_deployments` | read | `env1`, `env2` | Produces a side-by-side comparison of all application deployments across two environments. |

## Applications — deploy

Publish and deploy artifacts. Existing apps only have their artifact reference changed unless you ask otherwise.

| Tool | Access | Inputs | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deploy_jar` | ⚠️ write · confirm | `jarPath`, `appName`, `environment`, `assetId?`, `assetVersion?`, `groupId?`, `runtime?`, `replicas?`, `region?`, `vcores?`, `properties?`, `secureProperties?`, `jvmArgs?`, `wait?`, `expectedSha256?`, `confirm?` | One-call deploy of a locally built Mule application JAR: publishes it to Exchange, then deploys it to CloudHub 2.0 — creating the app if it does not exist, or safely updating just the artifact ref if it does. |
| `deploy_app` | ⚠️ write · confirm | `appName`, `environment`, `groupId`, `artifactId`, `version`, `runtime?`, `replicas?`, `region?`, `vcores?`, `properties?`, `secureProperties?`, `jvmArgs?`, `confirm?` | Deploys or redeploys a Mule application to CloudHub 2.0 using Maven coordinates (groupId:artifactId:version) referencing an artifact already published to Exchange. |
| `update_app_artifact` | ⚠️ write · confirm | `appName`, `environment`, `version`, `artifactId?`, `groupId?`, `packaging?`, `wait?`, `confirm?` | Safely redeploys an existing CloudHub 2.0 application to a new artifact version by PATCHing ONLY the application reference. |
| `rollback_app` | ⚠️ write · confirm | `appName`, `environment`, `toVersion?`, `wait?`, `confirm?` | Rolls an existing CloudHub 2.0 application back to a previous artifact by PATCHing only the application reference (runtime, target, replicas, and settings are preserved). |

## Applications — lifecycle

Restart, scale, stop, start, settings and deletion.

| Tool | Access | Inputs | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `restart_app` | ⚠️ write · immediate | `appName`, `environment` | Initiates a rolling restart of a deployed Mule application by re-applying its desired state. |
| `scale_app` | ⚠️ write · immediate | `appName`, `environment`, `replicas` | Changes the number of running replicas for a CloudHub 2.0 application. |
| `stop_app` | ⚠️ write · immediate | `appName`, `environment` | Stops a running Mule application in CloudHub 2.0 without deleting the deployment. |
| `start_app` | write · immediate | `appName`, `environment` | Starts a stopped Mule application in CloudHub 2.0. |
| `update_app_settings` | ⚠️ write · immediate | `appName`, `environment`, `properties?`, `secureProperties?` | Updates application properties for a deployed Mule application in CloudHub 2.0. |
| `delete_app` | ⚠️ write · confirm | `appName`, `environment`, `confirm?`, `expectedDeploymentId?`, `confirmProduction?` | Permanently deletes a CloudHub 2.0 application deployment while leaving its Exchange artifact and other Anypoint resources untouched. |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_logs` | read | `appName`, `environment`, `lines?`, `level?`, `search?` | Fetches the most recent log entries from a running Mule application. |

## Log analysis

Clustered errors with context, recurring patterns and health statistics.

| Tool | Access | Inputs | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `analyze_errors` | read | `appName`, `environment`, `hoursBack?`, `limit?` | Analyzes error patterns in a Mule application's logs. |
| `get_log_patterns` | read | `appName`, `environment`, `hoursBack?`, `topN?` | Identifies the most common recurring log message patterns in an application. |
| `get_log_stats` | read | `appName`, `environment`, `hoursBack?` | Returns a statistical health summary of an application's logs: level distribution, error rate, error spikes (time windows with elevated errors), noise percentage, and unique transaction count. |

## Monitoring

Traffic, failures, latency, JVM and host metrics. See [Monitoring](monitoring.md) for how to read them.

| Tool | Access | Inputs | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_metrics` | read | `environment?`, `hoursBack?`, `appName?`, `groupBy?` | Traffic, latency and failures from Anypoint Monitoring. |
| `get_runtime_metrics` | read | `environment`, `hoursBack?`, `appName?` | JVM and host health per worker/replica: total heap used (avg/peak) and committed; the old-generation pool with its limit and peak-to-limit ratio (the memory-pressure and leak signal); metaspace; old-generation GC collections and GC time inside the window; CPU count and physical RAM; system and process CPU load (avg/max); and average free physical memory. |
| `get_metrics_timeseries` | read | `environment`, `signal`, `hoursBack?`, `granularity?`, `appName?` | Bucketed metrics for trend and incident analysis. |
| `raw_amql_query` | read | `query`, `limit?`, `offset?` | Runs a freeform AMQL query against Anypoint Monitoring when the other metric tools do not answer the question. |

## Exchange

Search assets, read specs and publish application JARs.

| Tool | Access | Inputs | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `search_exchange` | read | `query?`, `type?`, `limit?` | Searches Anypoint Exchange for reusable assets: API specifications (RAML, OAS), connectors, integration templates, examples, and policies. |
| `get_exchange_asset` | read | `groupId`, `assetId`, `version?` | Returns detailed information about a specific Exchange asset including all published versions, dependencies, API instances, contact information, and file classifiers. |

| `publish_app_jar` | ⚠️ write · confirm | `jarPath`, `assetId?`, `assetVersion?`, `groupId?`, `expectedSha256?`, `confirm?` | Uploads a locally built Mule application JAR to Anypoint Exchange as a type "app" asset, using the Exchange v2 publication API (multipart, classifier mule-application). |

## Design Center

Read projects and files; writes and Exchange publication go through single-use preview tokens.

| Tool | Access | Inputs | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list_design_center_projects` | read | — | Lists all API specification projects in Anypoint Design Center. |
| `list_design_center_branches` | read | `project` | Lists branches for one exactly identified Design Center project. |
| `list_design_center_files` | read | `project`, `branch?` | Lists all files and folders in a Design Center project branch. |
| `read_design_center_file` | read | `project`, `filePath`, `branch?` | Reads the content of a specific file from a Design Center project. |
| `preview_create_design_center_project` | read | `name`, `classifier` | Checks exact-name collisions and returns a single-use 10-minute token. |
| `create_design_center_project` | write · preview token | `previewToken` | Consumes a single-use creation preview token and rechecks exact-name collision before creating the project. |
| `preview_sync_design_center_files` | read | `project`, `files`, `branch?`, `commitMessage?` | Computes create, update, and unchanged actions with content hashes. |
| `sync_design_center_files` | ⚠️ write · preview token | `previewToken` | Consumes a single-use preview, locks once, aborts atomically on hash conflicts, batch-saves, and verifies every changed file. |
| `preview_publish_exchange_asset` | read | `project`, `name`, `apiVersion`, `version`, `classifier`, `main`, `groupId`, `assetId`, `branch?` | Binds exact project, branch, coordinates, classifier, main file, API version, and source hash to a single-use token. |
| `publish_exchange_asset` | write · preview token | `previewToken` | Consumes the publication token, rejects source drift, publishes once, then verifies the downloaded Exchange artifact hash. |

## Anypoint MQ

Queues, statistics, dead-letter inspection and publishing.

| Tool | Access | Inputs | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list_queues` | read | `environment`, `region` | Lists all Anypoint MQ destinations (queues and exchanges) in an environment and region. |
| `get_queue_stats` | read | `environment`, `region`, `queueId` | Fetches current statistics for an Anypoint MQ queue: messages visible (ready to consume), messages in-flight (being processed), and lifetime totals for sent, received, and acknowledged messages. |
| `get_dlq_messages` | read | `environment`, `region`, `queueId`, `batchSize?` | Browses messages from an Anypoint MQ dead-letter queue without consuming them. |
| `publish_mq_message` | write · immediate | `environment`, `region`, `queueId`, `body`, `headers?`, `properties?` | Publishes a message to an Anypoint MQ queue. |
